source.title: DR 3170-001, End User Workstation Configurations
source.applicability: Workstation standards covering IT infrastructure components, interoperability, portability, and scalability requirements for endpoint inventory and configurations

passages.text: All USDA Mission Areas, agencies, and staff offices will comply with the latest version of NIST, Special Publication (SP) 800-53 r5, Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
